title: A coercive action evidenced only by the actor's own say-so
description: A non-trivial coercion is described and justified, but every supporting claim comes from the acting agent, with no corroboration and nothing from the affected party.
intended_goal: Evict the tenant for alleged lease violations.
prior_coercion_description: The landlord asserts the tenant breached the lease.

items.claim: The tenant repeatedly violated the lease.
items.notes: Asserted by the landlord; no independent record, no tenant account.
